CustomField.description: The Custom Email Alert this recipient rule belongs to. EmailService loads the active rules of an alert with it. A rule needs a Custom Email Alert, a Custom Teams Message, or both (validation rule AlertOrTeamsMessageRequired).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The email this recipient receives. Fill it together with Custom Teams Message so the same person also receives the Teams message, or leave it empty for a Teams-only recipient.
CustomField.label: Custom Email Alert
